summary: Blockchain Digital Infrastructure, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the closing of the full exercise of the underwriter's over-allotment option from its June 8, 2026 public offering. On June 17, 2026, the company sold an additional 4,999,999 shares at $1.65 per share, generating $7.75 million in net proceeds. Representative warrants for 200,000 shares were issued at $1.815 per share, exercisable until June 5, 2031. This is a routine capital markets transaction, not a special situation event.
